entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text:
By this petition filed as Public Interest Litigation, the petitioner has mainly prayed that the respondents shall cooperate by directing Local (Health) Authorities to provide paper-slips bearing the signature and code and serial number as required under Rule 16 (c) of the Prevention of Food Adulteration Rules,
1955 on demand of the recognized consumer associations so that provision contained in section 12 of the Prevention of Food Adulteration Act, 1954 is effectively implemented.
Admittedly, the Food Adulteration Act, 1954 has now been repealed vide notification dated 4.8.2011 and the Food Safety and Standard Act, 2006 has been enacted in its place.
As the provision of Food Adulteration Act itself has been repealed, we find no justification to proceed further in the present petition.

(AJIT SINGH) (SANJAY YADAV)
 JUDGE JUDGE ss Upbhokta Jagriti & Jan vs The Union Of India & Ors on 5 January, 2012 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/183482580/
